messages:
michael.h: Heads-up — Acme asked for a deep-dive call (Wed 10am PT) to go over incident response, key custody/KMS, audit logging, and evidence export. They attached SQ section 6 and want concrete flows + artifacts. Can we gather owners and short answers by EOD Mon? /cc @emma.s @josh.k
emma.s: I can own audit logging + SIEM integration. Need confirmation on retention windows (they asked for 2yrs for some logs) and an example ingest schema. Also need to know what fields we can safely redact for customer-facing artifacts.
josh.k: I’ll take KMS/key custody. Quick summary: we envelope-encrypt customer payloads. For Private/Dedicated customers we support BYOK with customer-managed CMKs; for Hosted we default to provider-managed CMKs. We provide key rotation history & KMS audit logs but we do NOT export raw key material. Need to check what attestation artifacts legal expects.
tara.p: Incident response owner — I’ll present our runbook + escalation matrix. Q: Acme expects 1 hour notification SLA for critical incidents. Is that a hard yes from SOC?
michael.h: Good. For the SQ they want sample audit logs showing admin RBAC changes, role assignment, and service principal actions. Emma, can you pull sanitized examples and redact hostnames?
emma.s: On it. Example sanitized snippet (will deliver as JSON lines):
```json
{
  "ts":"2025-04-01T12:34:56Z",
  "actor":"admin:alice",
  "action":"rbac.assign_role",
  "target":"team:redwood-infra",
  "role":"dedicated_admin",
  "request_id":"req-1234"
}
```
josh.k: For KMS specifics to put in the call:
- Envelope encryption: data key generated per-encryption, encrypted with CMK.
- Hosted: provider-managed CMKs (no customer key import).
- Dedicated/Private: support BYOK via KMS API + HSM-backed CMKs.
- We can provide rotation logs: key_version, rotate_time, principal who rotated.
Note: we cannot provide raw key material or exportable key blobs (HSM restriction).
samir.r: For vuln triage items in the SQ: we run SCA weekly + on PRs, maintain SBOM snapshots monthly, and have a documented CVE triage SLA (72 hours for high, 7 days for medium). We should attach latest SBOM and recent scan report.
sec-bot: :rotating_light: Alert — CVE-2025-0XYZ discovered in runtime-lib v2.0.0, patched in v2.1.3. Patch rollout started 2025-03-28 03:12Z; rollout complete 2025-03-29 07:10Z.
michael.h: For the evidence package we plan: redacted audit logs (admin actions), SBOM, runbook + example incident timeline, KMS attestation (rotation history), and RBAC policy snapshot. Emma/Josh/Tara — please confirm delivery paths and expected filenames.
emma.s: I will drop sanitized logs and a redaction matrix into /secure-share/acme/sanitized-logs/ by Tue AM. Filenames: acme_auditlog_redacted.jsonl and redaction_notes.md.
josh.k: I’ll generate a KMS attestation doc (key rotation timeline + access list) and place at /secure-share/acme/kms_attestation.pdf. May need legal to sign off on attestation language.
tara.p: I’ll prepare incident timeline template + escalation contact list and place in /secure-share/acme/incident_runbook.docx. Confirm we can meet 1-hour critical notification SLA: SOC on-call + pager + dedicated channel will meet that for incidents classified P0.
michael.h: One more clarification they asked: customer-managed KMS for Hosted offering? josh.k?
josh.k: Short answer: not supported for multi-tenant Hosted today. We offer BYOK only for Dedicated/Private deployments. We can document the reasoning (isolation, key usage tracking) and list Dedicated as the route for BYOK.
michael.h: OK. I’ll draft the written SQ responses and circulate for sign-off. Emma/Josh/Tara/Samir — please flag any items you think need legal or product approval. cc @sec-bot when you upload artifacts.
emma.s: noted. I’ll include examples for RBAC change logs (grant/revoke), service account rotations, and an example of our audit retention purge job config.
josh.k: Also will include a short diagram of envelope encryption flow and sample KMS API audit entries.
samir.r: Adding SCA export + SBOM snapshot to the package.
sec-bot: :white_check_mark: Files uploaded: acme_auditlog_redacted.jsonl, kms_attestation_draft.pdf (private link), sbom_snapshot_2025-03.json.
michael.h: Thanks team — I’ll send the draft to Acme by Tues noon PT and schedule the Wed call.
